caption: The Advanced → Lighting submenu contains the less frequently changed light properties.
alt: Lux Advanced Lighting submenu displaying five native properties.
capture_instructions: Capture the Lux dropdown with the Advanced submenu open and the Lighting section fully visible. Ensure all five labels and the numeric or checkbox controls are readable.

caption: Advanced Lux settings may alter supported shadows, specular highlights, fog and translucency without changing the level's lights.
alt: Advanced Lux lighting effects demonstrated in a fixed test scene.
capture_instructions: Record a controlled scene with fog, a reflective object and a translucent material. Keep camera and primary light controls fixed while adjusting Source Radius, Volumetric Scattering Intensity and Specular Scale separately. Clearly label each adjustment.

caption: Advanced Lighting controls map directly to native point-light properties.
alt: Lux advanced lighting setter diagram with ranges.
capture_instructions: Create a five-row chart mapping Advanced submenu controls to ULuxEditorSubsystem setter calls and UPointLightComponent operations. Indicate each numeric bound and label translucency as a boolean.

caption: The headlamp's brightness and reach can be adjusted independently while viewing the effect.
alt: Lux intensity and attenuation radius numeric scrubbing demonstration.
capture_instructions: Record Intensity being scrubbed up/down, then Attenuation Radius changing while keeping the camera fixed. Show the Lux native dropdown and nearby lit geometry throughout, with the two effects visible.

caption: The native menu writes editor-user preferences and the active transient point light together.
alt: Lux native menu fields mapped to subsystem properties and point light setters.
capture_instructions: Create a diagram showing the four Headlamp menu controls calling ULuxEditorSubsystem setters, which write ULuxUserSettings and update the transient UPointLightComponent. Show project range clamps only on Intensity and Attenuation Radius.

caption: Lux's temperature tint changes the character of the inspection light when Use Temperature is enabled.
alt: Lux color temperature changing from warm to cool in the same scene.
capture_instructions: Record the Lux Temperature submenu with Use Temperature checked; hold the viewport camera and material constant while scrubbing Kelvin from a warm value through 6500 K to a cooler value. Then disable Use Temperature to show the distinction.

caption: Color temperature is an optional tint applied together with the native Light Color setting.
alt: Lux Light Color and Use Temperature interaction diagram.
capture_instructions: Diagram a checkbox-controlled Kelvin field (1000–20000 K) and a separate Light Color swatch feeding the same point-light color result. Show Temperature disabled when Use Temperature is unchecked.

caption: The Lux icon and settings arrow occupy a compact native viewport toolbar control.
alt: Lux toolbar icon and separate settings dropdown arrow.
capture_instructions: Capture a perspective Level Editor viewport toolbar including the Lux icon and adjacent menu arrow, with enough surrounding controls to establish its position. Show the icon in its active Accent Blue state.

caption: The native Slate toolbar separates the Lux activation button from the settings menu.
alt: Slate widget hierarchy of Lux toolbar controls.
capture_instructions: Draw a labeled technical mockup of SHorizontalBox containing the SButton with SVG icon and SComboButton with arrow, with arrows to SetHeadlampState and MakeSettingsMenu. Include active/inactive tint annotations.
